mission_06: Interpolation methods fill missing values in time series by estimating intermediate points based on surrounding observations. Linear interpolation connects adjacent known points with straight lines, providing a simple and fast solution. Polynomial interpolation fits a polynomial curve through multiple points, capturing non-linear trends but potentially overshooting between points. Spline interpolation uses piecewise polynomials that are smooth at the connection points, offering the best balance between flexibility and stability. The choice of interpolation method depends on the underlying data pattern: linear for gradual changes, polynomial for smooth curves, and spline for complex non-linear trends. pandas interpolate method provides a unified interface for all these techniques, making it easy to experiment and find the best approach for your data.
